payload.entry: OWNERSHIP SPLIT (sase-1qd node): this phase owns tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_files_anchor_ownership.py::test_trailing_reserve_remeasures_when_flag_already_enabled and its production remeasure trigger (SectionViewMixin.refresh_section_layout_reserve in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_section_view.py). Contention phase sase-1rq.2.1.4 owns runner survival and any other contention failures; if it meets this node, it reuses this fix (landing via host completion from this phase) instead of a separate repair or quarantine.

ROOT CAUSE + FIX (sase-1qd): CI job 128401500987 timed out in the setup wait (line 364). Instrumented probe (old setup, just test-cov conditions: tools/run_pytest cov, SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=3, taskset -c 0,1, decks dir + repeats) failed 14/270 reps; every failure had the paged->spread _restore already run (reserve on, max_scroll_y=6) AND spread._layout_required=True with that _layout_updates generation already measured by a screen reflow. Textual 8.0.1 refresh(layout=True) only bumps _layout_updates when no layout is pending, and _get_box_model caches by it, so clear_cached_dimensions()+refresh(layout=True) never re-called get_content_height (0 measures over 5s). Not delayed rendering/content change. Fix: SectionViewMixin.refresh_section_layout_reserve also clears _box_model_cache (production remeasure trigger, shared with Main block nav). Test: setup now waits for the restore-landed reserved state (_ready_reserved_spread) and drives the production refresh_section_layout_reserve(); setup waits name anchor/real height/extent/reserve/section+anchor generation/layout_pending/layout_updates on timeout; new deterministic test_reserve_remeasure_survives_pending_measured_layout runs the interleave synchronously. No timeout raised, no assertion weakened.

VERIFICATION: (1) loaded: taskset -c 0,1 env REPEAT_N=150 SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=3 .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest cov tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/ + scratch repeat wrapper (150x trailing node, 50x new test) -> 933 passed, 0 failed (same conditions failed 7/120 and 7/150 before). (2) Mutations: removing the 2e68053dab panel/enable remeasure triggers -> trailing test fails 8/8 with the original CI signature (max_scroll_y=0 live_target=6 pending=1 retry=8); removing only the _box_model_cache clear -> new test fails 12/12; both restored. (3) tools/run_pytest fast on decks dir + prompt_panel section-navigation/bottom-pin + main_deck_reply_steal_recovery + live_reply_follow_mounted* -> 767 passed. (4) just test-visual -- agents_deck_views_files/deck_blocks/deck_views_main -> check clean, 18 unchanged. (5) sase tool run check 1f6a2e195aedc1bf5a23fa4fe0a9397e succeeded. Landed via host completion from this phase (find the sase-1rq.2.1.5.1.1 commit on master; SHA not known at turn end). Integration re-check: tools/run_pytest fast tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_files_anchor_ownership.py

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Textual 8 swallows layout remeasures behind a measured pending request — any Static.update()/refresh(layout=True) on a widget whose pending layout generation a reflow already measured keeps the stale box-model height; only the section reserve path is hardened here. Consider an upstream Textual report or a shared remeasure helper for other auto-height views.

Root-caused sase-1qd: Textual 8 refresh(layout=True) does not advance the box-model cache key while a layout is pending, so the reserve remeasure was swallowed after a reflow measured the spread first (14/270 loaded probe failures, all with layout_pending=True and no remeasure). Fixed refresh_section_layout_reserve to clear _box_model_cache; regression setup now waits for the restore-landed state and uses the production trigger with diagnostics; new deterministic interleave test. Loaded cov 3-worker/2-CPU run 933/933 passed; trigger-removal mutation fails 8/8, fix-removal fails 12/12; nearby deck/section/Main tests 767 passed; targeted visual check clean; sase tool run check 1f6a2e195aedc1bf5a23fa4fe0a9397e succeeded. No timeout raised.

Mechanism proven by trace: sticky Reply chat-log landing rests above Reply anchor; a same-subject enrichment re-delivery (Context grows with SASE CONTEXT resolving sections, then shrinks) follow-re-lands programmatically and _on_main_scroll_y derived Context (stored=context, view=reply). Fix: new decks/delivery_hold.py CardDocumentDeliveryHoldMixin, a token-bound hold claimed by same-subject Main spread re-render (with anchor-relative restore for parked readers, carried across a second delivery) and by sticky/follow landings; Main watcher keeps the held card; released after 2 quiet refresh checks (cap 12), by scroll_to_card/scroll_to_block, new subject, paged mode, or empty doc; derived scrolls now sync the view card (adopt_spread_active). payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Isolate process-global Agents row-overlay caches across all visual tests — agent_stranded._STRANDED_REPORT_CACHE, agent_wait_beads._WAIT_BEAD_STATUS_CACHE and agent_bead._BEAD_DISPLAY_CACHE survive between AcePage tests in one xdist worker (CI worksteal runs ~470 consecutive visual tests per process), so a capture can inherit stranded flags, wait counts and panel widths from an earlier test with the same bead ids. This phase isolates them only in test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_stranded.py; promoting an autouse fixture to tests/ace/tui/visual/conftest.py needs a full `sase tool run test-visual` comparison.

visual-fixtures fixed on base c732c6e38e (tree lands via host completion; text patch also applies cleanly onto origin/master 578a317bcf). (1) agents_stranded_resolve_modal_120x40 — cause: test-order leak. CI worksteal runs the stranded module in one process; rows_and_clan left a stranded report and warm wait-bead status in process-global caches, so the modal first paint already showed [W2?1 D1] ⚐1 ▲▲. Reproduced byte-for-byte: CI actual md5 bae502d8 (identical in 4 CI runs) == local `just test-visual <module> -n 1` actual. Also a real UI defect: a stranded flag that widens a clan row never painted — _try_patch_agent_row declined (width_growth), the fallback rebuild skipped the panel because rows and paint key were unchanged, and the failed patch left its unpainted render cached. Fix: patch_row declines by invalidating the agent render-cache entry and clearing _panel_paint_key; _try_patch_agent_row clears the paint key on decline; the stranded module isolates the three caches per test; the modal test settles the startup warmup, publishes via _apply_bead_warmup_results and waits for ⚐1. Only that golden updated (inspected): it differs from the CI actual solely in the second wave pip (○ vs leaked ▲, 34x11 px). (2) artifacts_beads_empty_120x40 — cause: "inbox: " painted #1c1b1a (= background) because NotificationIndicator cached a transparent-foreground VisualStyle before the App had its color rule. On a fast-stylesheet cache hit AcePage dropped Textual queued initial refresh_css, so the App stayed unstyled until after Compose/Resize and under load the screen painted first; Textual never invalidates descendant visual styles. Same signature in CI run 42297547091 (artifacts_split narrow, commits_origin_legend). Fix: on a hit, swap that refresh for a parse-free stylesheet.update(app). Golden unchanged. Contention repro (2 CPUs, beads+split x40-80, -n12-16): before 2-4 failures per batch and 38-114 transparent-style events; after 2x160 runs, 0 failures and 0 events. Regressions: test_width_growth_decline_leaves_the_stale_row_to_a_rebuild and test_ace_page_fast_stylesheet_cache_styles_app_before_widgets_mount each fail with their fix reverted; the modal test times out on ⚐1 without the UI fix. Verified: `just test-visual` both selectors together clean (local and TZ=UTC, unstable=[]), each alone clean; stranded module -n 1 / default / UTC drifts only detail_header and blocked_detail (AGENT PROMPT heading family, red in CI too, owned by sase-1r2.6). Full `sase tool run test-visual` 9c022624: 110 drifts, all within CI run 42370668331 failure set, both selectors pass. 230 targeted nonvisual tests pass; `sase tool run check` 68aa87b6 succeeded.

The demonstrated leaking stranded-module pair is now isolated before and after each test, and its modal fixture settles real warmup. The other explicitly seeding visual module (agents_waiting) already clears its wait-status cache at its fixture seams. No additional failing pair is identified after this repair. The feature task catalog refuses agent creation, and these optional extensions are not refiled as bugs.
